source_evidence: To figure out how the costs of mutual fund classes add up over time and to compare the costs of different classes, you can use the FINRA Fund Analyzer.
answer: The FINRA Fund Analyzer can help you compare how the costs of different mutual fund share classes add up over time. This matters because classes of the same fund invest in the same portfolio but may have different fees and expenses. When comparing classes, consider total costs—not just sales charges, but also ongoing fees and other operating expenses.
